facts.text: Galen offers a pre-licensure Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) that compresses the standard four-year curriculum into three years with prerequisites built directly into the program.

sources.title: Nursing Programs | Galen College of Nursing
sources.quote: Three-Year Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN): Earn a bachelor's degree in nursing in three years instead of four, with eligibility to sit for the NCLEX-RN.
